verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management platform. Its agents handle business workflows such as boards, items, reports and meetings, so having a coding agent detect and install toolchains is outside its product category. The managed sandboxes and the developer MCP (scaffolding apps, setting env vars, promoting versions) concern hosting and building monday apps. Nothing in the evidence shows a coding agent that installs toolchains or dependencies, so the axis does not apply.
